summary: Round 11, graph lens, 26 Sep 17:01-17:12Z. HONEST ANSWER: nothing in the linking/gap/division focus reaches R8 (27 Sep 12:00 UTC); finals stay #37 + #38; no OK request. New this round: a 2.5-min CPU measurement on the exp60 x138 lab (56 clips, official metric) with base = ins35 (the #35-config insertion on the final graph = K2 minus lowrefine; reproduces 0.93988, div TP/FP/FN 25/31/74). (1) The only non-net route to the 'no fork' FN divisions is attaching a track START as the second daughter of a one-child parent (geometry only). It is strongly negative: with mirror/sister gates -0.01285 (+7 TP / +200 FP forks, evaluable precision 3.4%, W/L 7/39); nearest-parent version -0.02725 (+17 TP / +698 FP, 2.4%). This is I-047 re-measured on x138, same verdict. (2) A perfect image classifier on that pool would give at most +0.0054 (7 TP pool); the +0.0131 of the wide pool needs ~40x enrichment (2.4% -> >= 50%), while measured image cues give AUC 0.73 (I-056) or precision 4-15% (I-076). (3) The GT-oracle removal of EVERY false fork gives only +0.0063 (44b6 +0.0070, 6bba +0.0058; W/L 15/5). So no fork-removal rule, image-based or not, can reach the ~+0.012 lab bar (= +0.002 public at the ~1/6 transfer). (4) The linking/gap ceilings are smaller: both-free end->start breaks 11/1,705 FN (~+0.0003, I-164); dangling ends <= ~+0.003 at 100% precision (I-200); RE-AIM is a no-op (I-170); post-freeze re-solve +0.0063, 6bba only and deferred (I-242). The bar can be reached only by an oracle over the whole division term (all FP removed AND >= ~17 recovered forks at >= ~50% precision). That needs a trained far-daughter model, which is post-deadline item 6 (I-079). Nothing was submitted, pushed or committed. The only files written are this JSON and its notes; the scripts are in the session scratchpad.
lab_bar: R4 needs public >= K2 + 0.002. The insertion transferred lab +0.0058/+0.0065 -> LB +0.001 twice (~1/6), so ~+0.012 in-sample lab is required. Division-term arithmetic on the K2-like base: score = adjEdgeJ + 0.1*divJ, divJ 25/130 = 0.192; +0.012 needs divJ >= ~0.31, e.g. 25+k TP with k >= ~15 at 100% precision or k >= ~20 at 50%.

findings.what: ORPHAN-START SECOND-DAUGHTER ATTACH on the K2-like graph (the geometry-only route to the 'no fork within +-4 frames' FN divisions; I-047 on x138). Mechanism: a track start v (t > 0, in-degree 0) is attached as a second child of a parent u at t-1 that has exactly one child c. Variant A adds gates: |uv| <= 12 um, sister |cv| 5-14 um, mirror residual |u - (c+v)/2| <= 3 um, greedy by residual, each u and v used once. Variant B takes the nearest one-child parent within 12 um. No ILP or edge-net input. MEASURED on 56 exp60 clips (official metric, base ins35 0.93988, div 25/31/74). A: -0.01285 pooled (44b6 -0.01215, 6bba -0.01305); div 32/231/67, i.e. +7 TP for +200 evaluable FP forks (precision 3.4% vs the lab break-even 0.114); 9,118 edges added; clip W/L 7/39. B: -0.02725; div 42/729/57 (+17 TP / +698 FP, 2.4%); 29,605 edges; W/L 3/50. VERDICT: refuted by measurement on x138. The old I-047 closure (honest 1 TP / 31 FP on the old base) holds on x138. Unannotated cells are free, so the 9-30k added edges cost nothing directly; the loss comes from the ~2-7% of candidates on annotated non-dividing tracks.

findings.what: IMAGE-EVIDENCE FILTER over the orphan-attach pool (mitotic brightening or condensation of u at t-1, elongation of u along the c-v axis from second moments of the raw intensity, daughter shrink at t and t+1; no net). This is the concrete form of the round focus: recover 'no fork' FN divisions with image evidence. CEILING ARITHMETIC from r11g-1: a PERFECT filter on the gated pool keeps 7 TP and 0 FP, giving 32/(32+31+67) = 0.246, i.e. +0.0054 lab. That is below the ~+0.012 bar even at oracle. On the wide pool (17 TP among 715 evaluable candidates) the ceiling is 42/130 = 0.323 (+0.0131). Reaching the bar would need precision >= ~50% from a 2.4% base (~20-40x enrichment). The image cues measured so far give parent-intensity AUC 0.73 (I-056 B22) and DC-rescue precision 4-15% (I-076). Runtime: raw-frame crops around ~10-30k candidates per 100 clips, ~+5-15 min CPU. Cheapest honest gate: an exp60 CPU arm with thresholds fixed in advance, reading SELECTION and CONFIRMATION separately (needs raw train zarr crops; about half a day of code, ~1 h CPU). VERDICT: does not reach R8. It is below the bar at oracle on the gated pool and needs an unreached enrichment on the wide pool. It is the manual version of post-deadline item 6 (learned far-daughter slot, I-079).
